heading: Authorization of appropriations for acquisition of additional lands
lead: For the acquisition of lands authorized in section 267 of this title, there are authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary, but not more than $427,500.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was not enacted as part of act June 11, 1940, ch. 304, 54 Stat. 262, which comprises this subchapter.
